title: Nano Banana 2.1
description: Google Nano Banana 2.1 — fast text-to-image and image editing with sharper output and cleaner in-image text than Nano Banana 2. Edit or compose from up to 9 reference images (free), render at 1K, 2K or 4K, and optionally ground the image in live web results or web images. Billing: per image by size — 1K = 45, 2K = 70, 4K = 150 credits. Search grounding is off by default and adds per image: google_search +10, image_search +20 (it includes a web search). Use POST /v1/cost for an exact quote.
pricing_text: Pricing: 45 credits per generation (varies by resolution).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. "auto" (default) follows the first reference image when editing and gives a square image for text-to-image.

google_search.description: Ground the image in live Google Search results (weather, scores, recent events, current facts). Off by default. Adds 10 credits per image.

image_search.description: Let the model look up web images as visual context before rendering. Off by default. Runs a web search too, so it adds 20 credits per image in total, with or without google_search.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. Each image is billed at its size's price, plus search grounding if enabled.

output_format.description: File format of the result: png or jpeg, always at full resolution (16:9 at 4K is 5504x3072 either way; the PNG is about 20 MB, the JPEG a few MB). Omit it to get the file as the model produced it, which is a PNG or a near-lossless JPEG.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Reference images cost nothing extra.

size.description: Output resolution tier. Sets the price: 1K = 45, 2K = 70, 4K = 150 credits per image.
